verdict.rationale: gstack's automations are skills and codified scripts, and the evidence touches only parts of the story. Dev mode reads skills straight from a git checkout, which implies they can be versioned like code. /learn lets you review, search, prune and export what the agent has learned, and per-project skills can be promoted to global. The /review and /ship skills act on your application code's diffs and PRs, not on the automations themselves. Missing for 10: any documented way to version, diff or review saved skills and codified scripts, any rollback or restore for automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
